note: PLD (n-gram context lookup) vs production MTP on heretic Q4_K_S, llama.cpp 434ddbb Vulkan, 250 W. Forced 512 tokens per stream, temp 0, seed 42. Assembled from the run outputs of scripts/core19/pld_conc.py; server relaunched with matching -np for each level. Decode includes speculation.

single_stream.note: one request on a server launched with the given -np. Confirms -np is capacity, not a per-stream tax.

concurrent.note: N identical streams launched at once on a server with -np=N. per_stream is the mean decode across streams; aggregate is total server tokens/s.

kv_and_vram.note: -kvu (unified KV): n_ctx_slot stays 262144 at every -np (shared pool, not split per slot, not replicated).
